subject.title: [Feature]: Discord thread-reply mention gate — respond to thread starter freely, require mention for follow-up replies

question: Should Discord get an opt-in autoThread follow-up mention gate, and what public config shape should own it?
rationale: The source-level gap is clear, but the fix adds public Discord config surface and changes which thread replies reach the agent, so automation should not choose the permanent API or default semantics.

options.title: Add opt-in explicit follow-up gate
options.body: Introduce a default-off Discord option that requires explicit mentions for bot-owned autoThread follow-up replies while preserving current starter behavior and existing-user defaults.

options.title: Fold into broader thread override
options.body: Resolve this only as part of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/75938, accepting that parent/thread and starter/follow-up semantics need one combined design.

options.title: Keep current continuation behavior
options.body: Decline the new config surface and document that bot-owned autoThreads intentionally keep replying without mentions after the starter message.

recommendation.title: Add opt-in explicit follow-up gate
recommendation.body: Introduce a default-off Discord option that requires explicit mentions for bot-owned autoThread follow-up replies while preserving current starter behavior and existing-user defaults.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest routing candidate from current mention-gating, Discord preflight, and compatibility-sensitive config history.
